name: legate
description: Delegated authority over tmux sessions. Dispatch AI agents (Claude Code, Codex) to work in parallel, debrief them for status, inspect their workspace yourself, or watch them for changes.

interface.shortDescription: Dispatch and manage tmux agent sessions
interface.longDescription: Launch Claude Code or Codex sessions in tmux windows, send follow-up instructions, debrief their progress, inspect sessions directly, and watch them for changes.
defaultPrompt: Dispatch a separate agent session for this task.
